$comment-3: POST-CEREMONY 2026-05-12: LEAN-side broker swapped from InteractiveBrokersBrokerage → PaperBrokerage. The bare quantconnect/lean:latest image does NOT ship QuantConnect.Brokerages.InteractiveBrokers.dll, so live-mode boot threw `Sequence contains no matching element` from LEAN's Composer broker-factory lookup. PaperBrokerage is LEAN's built-in zero-dependency simulator. The api owns the real IBKR broker contract via services/execution/ibkr_adapter.py — LEAN only generates signals + POSTs them. See Docs/decisions-log.md 2026-05-12 'Post-ceremony session' entry for the full rationale.
$comment-4: Post-pivot deploy: docker compose up -d lean_local. The container's entrypoint resolves sops bundle → env var LEAN_LOCAL_BEARER_TOKEN, then deep-merges this template on top of upstream LEAN's config.json and launches LEAN Launcher.

Runs locally via LEAN Local + PaperBrokerage (no IBKR DLL); signals POSTed to the api which dispatches via ib-async (Pivot-PR-A post-pivot + post-ceremony 2026-05-12).
$comment-parameters: Mirrors strategies/v1_trend_following/parameters.py V1_DEFAULTS. The algorithm reads them via self.get_parameter(...) with V1_DEFAULTS as fallback. Keys are the canonical agent `tighten_parameter` enum names (backend-spec §12.3) — never rename without a parameter_sets migration.

environments.$comment: LEAN Local environments. The `lean_local` Docker container's entrypoint deep-merges this section on top of the upstream `/Lean/Launcher/bin/Debug/config.json` defaults (Pivot-PR-F). The handler bindings under paper-internal below mirror upstream's `live-paper` environment shape — but with `FakeDataQueue` substituted for upstream's `LiveDataQueue` (the upstream choice is a stub that throws `NotImplementedException` on Subscribe; `FakeDataQueue` is the real built-in that aggregates fake ticks via `IDataQueueHandler` + `IDataQueueUniverseProvider`). Production env is selected at runtime via `LEAN_LIVE_MODE`: `false` (default) → backtesting, `true` → paper-internal.

backtesting.$comment: Backtest against QC bundled historical bars. Used in CI golden tests + ad-hoc parameter sweeps. No broker dependency. Inherits backtesting handlers from upstream config.json defaults via the entrypoint deep-merge.

paper-internal.$comment-1: Live-mode operation under LEAN's built-in PaperBrokerage simulator. No real exchange connection — LEAN's strategy never places orders (the api owns broker contract via services/execution/ibkr_adapter.py). PaperBrokerage satisfies the IBrokerage interface for LEAN's internal subscription + scheduling machinery; portfolio queries return flat positions (LEAN doesn't own positions post-pivot; the api does).
paper-internal.$comment-2: Handler bindings mirror upstream LEAN's `live-paper` environment with one substitution: `data-queue-handler` uses `FakeDataQueue` (real built-in) instead of upstream's `LiveDataQueue` (NotImplementedException stub). `history-provider` is `SubscriptionDataReaderHistoryProvider` only — reads daily bars from `/Lean/Data/`; PaperBrokerage does NOT provide history. `transaction-handler` is `BacktestingTransactionHandler` because PaperBrokerage simulates fills internally and needs the simulator handler, not the real-broker `BrokerageTransactionHandler`.
paper-internal.$comment-3: This env covers both paper-trading and live-trading operation. LEAN's behavior is identical whether the api is configured for paper or live IBKR — the api decides at its own broker layer (ib-async paper vs live port). No separate `live-internal` env needed.
